business_summary: Virtualex Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in IT and consulting, and outsourcing business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in contact center operation; acts as generalists; onsite team engineering, offshore development, and IT operation outsourcing businesses; research and development, and acquisition of new technology and solution. It also provides consultation, outsourcing, and CRM software development services; web system, educational solution, and research and development related to AI; operational base for contact center outsourcing and BPO service; and digital marketing services. The company was formerly known as Virtualex Consulting, Inc. and changed its name to Virtualex Holdings, Inc. in October 2017. Virtualex Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Atrae, Inc. plans, develops, and manages job information websites in Japan. The company offers Green, a contingency-based recruitment media that matches jobseekers who wish to change jobs with hiring companies on the internet; Wevox, an organizational capabilities platform that promotes the utilization and retention of human resources by visualizing engagement; and Yenta, a matching application that uses artificial intelligence to create encounters between businesspeople. It also establishes a professional basketball club, Altiri Chiba, in Chiba City. Atrae, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: CAREER CO., LTD. engages in the provision of human resources services for aging society in Japan. It engages in general worker dispatch, outsourcing, recruitment consulting, and job advertisement, business contract; and paid employment placement businesses. The company also offers staffing services for nurses and caregivers who support these services, labor dispatch personnel introductions, and home care services; employment support services for people with disabilities; HR tech services; and temporary staffing services. CAREER CO., LTD. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: SERAKU Co., Ltd. operates as internet system integrator in Japan. It offers digital transformation services, including cloud technologies and cybersecurity for protecting the information assets of companies, IoT service, AI and data science, robotic process automation, and Midori cloud; maintenance and operation service of 24-hour/365-day on SERAKUs IoT cloud support center; and customer success solutions business for the use of Salesforce. The company also provides Midori cloud and farm cloud services to support in agriculture and fisheries sectors; and system integration services, such as IT infrastructure and cloud technologies, digital creative, web operations, web system development, and other services. In addition, it provides mechanical design engineering services, such as engineer dispatch, commissioned contracting, and engineer training services for design and development centered on CAD and drafting technology. SERAKU Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Howa Machinery, Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of machine tools, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment, firearms, special-purpose vehicles, building materials, electronic machines, sweepers, metal joinery fittings, and firearms in Japan. It operates through seven segments: Machine Tool Related, Firearms, Specially Equipped Vehicle, Building Materials, Real Estate Leasing, Domestic Sales Subsidiary, and Domestic Transportation Subsidiary. The company's machine tools include machining centers, transfer lines, and standard machine tool units for transfer lines; and pneumatic and hydraulic equipment comprises power chucks, rotating cylinders, rodless slit and magnetic type cylinders, hydraulic and pneumatic clamp cylinders, hydraulic jig cylinders, rotary actuators, and hydraulic cylinders. It also provides electronic machines, which include exposure systems for printed circuit boards, ceramic green sheet-related equipment, and testing systems for mounted circuit boards; sweepers used for cleaning in streets, factories, and public and leisure facilities; and sporting rifles. The company was formerly known as Howa Heavy Industries, Ltd. and changed its name to Howa Machinery, Ltd. in 1945. Howa Machinery, Ltd. was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Kiyosu, Japan.

business_summary: Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. engages in paper converting machinery business in Japan. It offers corrugated cardboard box making and printing machines, cardboard weight packaging machines, and yarn twisting machines, as well as defense equipment. The company was formerly known as Ishii Iron Works and changed its name to Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. in July 1938. Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Hakusan, Japan.

NPR-Riken Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automobile engine parts, marine engine parts, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts Business, Piping and Construction Equipment Business, Thermal Engineering Business, and Other segments. It offers piston rings for automobiles, construction machinery, marine engines, and power generation; evaluation and simulation analysis services, piston ring museum; marine and industrial components and parts, seal rings for industrial equipment; resin seal rings, resin gears; precision machined components, such as turbo changer seal rings, valve lifters, aluminum vanes, cylinder liners; sintered components, including valve seat inserts, powder metal assembled camshafts, material to strengthen bearing; cast iron components comprising suspension and steering, cast iron camshafts; piping products; thermal engineering, consists heating element PYROMAX, industrial furnaces, heater units; EMC, electromagnetic anechoic chambers; metal injection molding components; surface treatment technologies, DLC and TiN coating; electric unit products; engineered plastic products; electromagnetic noise countermeasure products; NiFreeT, a titanium-tantalum alloy products; medical and disaster emergency products, such as disaster emergency medical, dental implant, radiology medical devices, and other products; and recreation vehicles products. NPR-Riken Corporation was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. NPR-Riken Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Npr-Riken Corporation.

business_summary: Tsudakoma Corp. produces and sells textile machinery and machine tool attachments in Japan, Asia, North and south America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Textile Machinery Business and Machine Tool Related Business. The company offers textile machinery comprising air jet looms, water jet looms, and preparatory machines. It also provides composite machinery, such as prepreg slitters, automated fiber lay-up machines, auto lay-up machines, multi-axial UD auto lay-up systems, auto edge welding machines, profile molding machines, carbon fiber rapier looms, and drape forming systems. In addition, the company offers machines, including NC rotatory tables, machine vises, and manual tables. Further, it provides castings for textile machinery and preparation machinery, machine tool attachments, and various industrial machinery. The company was formerly known as TSUDAKOMA Industrial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tsudakoma Corp. in 1982. Tsudakoma Corp. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Kanazawa, Japan.

business_summary: ENSHU Limited manufactures and sells machine tools and parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers system equipment, such as flexible transfer lines, flexible manufacturing systems, and other production lines controlled by computers; and general-purpose machines, which include machining centers and NC machines, as well as high power laser diode and diode plastic welding systems. It also manufactures parts for motorcycle engines, snowmobiles, golf carts, buggies, and other vehicles; and machines and assembles diesel engines. The company was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan.

Shima Seiki Mfg.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, sells, markets, and services knitting machines, design systems, and automatic fabric cutting machines in Japan, Europe, the Middle East, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers computerized flat, and glove and sock knitting machines under the WHOLEGARMENT brand; and peripherals. It also provides SDS-ONE APEX series, which consists of an all-in-one system, a design system with integrated hardware and software; and APEXFiz, a design software subscription service. In addition, the company offers P-CAM, a series of automatic fabric cutting machines; P-LAB automatic labeling machines; P-SPR 2 spreading machines; PMK 1600/2000 inkjet marking plotters; CAD/CAM systems; and SHIMA KnitManager, a production management software. Further, it is involved in the provision of service and maintenance services; manufacture of machine parts; production of cashmere yarns; sale of REPAC and ReMateri yarns; operation of BLUEKNIT, an online shopping mall for knits; Auberge de South Terrace, a hotel located in Nanki Shirahama; food services business; and operates Fusion museum. The company serves fashion, sports/outdoor, healthcare, shoes and accessories, home furnishings, automotive, aeronautical, and industrial materials industries. Shima Seiki Mfg.,Ltd. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Wakayama, Japan.

business_summary: Seibu Giken Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells environmental conservation and energy-saving equipment in Japan, China, rest of Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. It offers DRY-SAVE desiccant dehumidifiers, VOC concentrators, total heat and sensible heat exchangers, outdoor air handling unit, dry air globoxes, circulating nitrogen purifiers, dry room dehumidifier, dry and nitrogen gas booths, solvent recovery systems, and direct air capture CO2 concentrations device for greenhouse and vertical. The company provides honeycomb and after-sales services. Its products are used in various applications, such as for lithium-ion battery, semiconductor, OLED, perovskite solar cell, perovskite solar cell, building air conditioning, power plant, chemical product, painting and printing, and food and pharmaceuticals. The company was formerly known as Seibu Giken Technology Research Co., Ltd. and changed its name Seibu Giken Co.Ltd in July 1995. Seibu Giken Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Koga, Japan.

business_summary: JRC Co.,Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells conveyor parts in Japan. It operates through Conveyor Business, Environmental Plant Business, and Robot SI Business segments. The company offers laura, pulley, and stand; belt cleaner, conveyor cover, safety products and other conveyor peripherals; apron, belt, screw, and flight conveyor; storage hopper, double damper, rotary dust and quantitative feeder, tank, duct, and mounting stand; and idlers, rollers, and lightweight idlers and rollers. It also provides services in conveyor equipment operation; conveyor equipment maintenance service; conveyor construction; installation work, renovation and improvement work, renewal work, regular inspection of equipment, equipment maintenance, and research and installation of other companies' products. business_summary: AIMECHATEC, Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells for flat panel display equipment in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, and internationally. The company operates through Semiconductor Related Business; LCD Business; and IJP Solution Business segments. The company offers plasma asher, etcher, UV equipment for power semiconductor production, wafer handling systems, and solder ball mounters. It also provides seal application, liquid crystal dropping, and vacuum lamination equipment used in the production process of liquid crystal display panels for televisions, smartphones. In addition, it provides after-sales services. Further, it offers life cycle support services, such as process support, proposal for latest equipment and mechanism, renewal and maintenance, research and development, and training; and spare parts. AIMECHATEC, Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is based in Ryugasaki, Japan.

business_summary: Okumura Engineering corp. engages in the development, manufacturing, and sales of various valves for industrial, building, and marine applications. It manufactures and sells butterfly pipes used in construction, power generation, shipbuilding, and various plants industries. The company also provides fluid control equipment; pinch and knife gate valves; land-based applications such as building equipment, petrochemicals, steel and metals, electricity and gas, machinery and equipment, and paper and pulp industries; and marine based products to various shipyards. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Yasu, Japan.

Sanei Ltd. manufactures and sells plumbing fixtures in Japan. The company provides mixing plugs, sensors and touch faucets, set items, washbasin and hand washbasin, single faucet, shower, interior accessories, branch, faucet parts, valve, piping system, piping components, kitchen accessories, bath and air conditioning accessories, washbasin accessories, washing machine accessories, toilet accessories, gardening accessories, and tools. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: KLASS Corporation manufactures and sells professional machines and tools in Japan. It operates through four segments: Professional, Consumer, Industry, and New Industry. The Professional segment offers interior construction equipment, such as automatic wallpaper gluing machines; sign/display related equipment that comprises film laminating machines; tapes for interior work and related tools; computer software; Tatami manufacturing equipment, which includes a computerized Tatami manufacturing system, as well as related tools/auxiliary materials; and Goolip, a quotation and billing management tool. The Consumer segment engages in the sale of interior products, such as special function tatami mats; provision of replacement of tatami mats and sliding doors for general households; and sale and installation of industrial and residential solar power generation systems, and storage batteries, as well as offers house renovation work. The Industry segment designs, develops, and manufactures industrial equipment, such as secondary battery manufacturing equipment; and sells food equipment for kitchens comprising multi-dispensers. The New Industry segment offers water jet technology, and develops and sells automation systems. The company was formerly known as Kyokuto Sanki Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to KLASS Corporation in October 2023. KLASS Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tatsuno, Japan.

business_summary: Optorun Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells optical thin film equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, Vietnam, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers ion source beam assisted deposition system, including optical thin film coaters, super multilayer optical coaters, and optical thin film coater for mass production; reactive plasma deposition system; metal mode sputtering system, such as optical thin film and optical wafer level sputtering coaters; and plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition system. It also provides iron sources; and optical monitors. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacturing, distribution, import, and export of vacuum coating machines, peripheral equipment, and units using vacuum coating products; and provision of maintenance and consulting services. Its products are used in clean energy, display, optical communications, semiconductor, optical storage media, bio-industry, consumer products, and vehicle-mounted device applications. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tsurugashima, Japan.

business_summary: Iwaki Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacturing, procurement, and sales of chemical pumps and peripheral equipment in Japan, Europe, the United States, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers magnetic drive pumps, motor driven metering pumps, electromagnetic metering pumps, pneumatic drive pumps, rotary displacement pumps, air pumps, and reciprocating diaphragm liquid pumps; and non-metal magnetic drive turbine pumps MDT series and metallic centrifugal magnetic drive pumps MP series. It also provides system products comprising water treatment controllers, such as Walchem controller Intuition-9, Walchem controller Intuition-6, and Walchem controller P100 and W100. Iwaki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: Nagaoka International Corporation manufactures and sells water intake and treatment systems, and screen internals to the oil refining and petrochemical industries in Japan and internationally. It also provides water intake screens for groundwater and other purposes, such as waterworks, industrial facilities, farming, and fish farms; and the technology of water treatment for drinkable and commercial use. The company was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Nagaoka International Corporation is a subsidiary of HAMADA Co., Ltd.

株式会社ナガオカのスクリーン・インターナルは、世界各国の石油精製・化学プラントに納入され、日々の生活に必要な燃料や化学原料の生産工程で使用されています。クリーンエネルギーであるプロパンガスを用いたプロピレンの生産でも使用され、環境配慮型社会の一翼をになっております。 詳細へ 水関連事業 ナガオカ・スクリーンは、地下水をはじめとしたさまざまな水源からの取水に使用されており、日本国内外で1,000件以上のプロジェクトに採用されています。また、取水した地下水を無薬注で処理可能なケミレスをはじめとした独自の水処理技術のラインナップで、お客様の求める”水”を提供しています。 詳細へ NAGAOKA INSIGHT ニュースレター 株式会社ナガオカの事業（エネルギー・水関連事業）が、世界や社会にどのように携わっているのかをご紹介するため、ニュースレター『NAGAOKA INSIGHT』(不定期便)を発行しております。 本レターを通じ、ナガオカの技術は「普段目にすることがない、けれど意外に身近で、今後の社会を支える存在」である事を、少しでもご実感頂ければ幸甚です。 Volume17 次世代養殖を支える「ケミレス」 株式会社ナガオカの水処理装置「ケミレス」は、さまざまな用途で活用が広がっています。今回は、ウナギやフグの陸上養殖に取り組む「美浜アクアファーム」（愛知県知多郡美浜町）の事例を通して、養殖における水管理とケミレスの活用をご紹介します。 Volume16 表流水：新たな「取水分野」への挑戦 株式会社ナガオカは、パシフィックコンサルタンツ株式会社と共同開発で、川やダムなどの「表流水」向けのスクリーンを開発し、共同で特許出願を行いました。今回は、当社が挑戦する「表流水」の取水分野をご紹介します。 Volume15 スマート農業と「ケミレス」 株式会社ナガオカの水処理装置「ケミレス」は、上水道だけではなく、近年様々な用途に使われ始めています。今回は、“水”と密接に関係する“農業”の現場で、トマト栽培の最先端設備を導入されている「みちのく白河農園様」の事例を元にご紹介致します。 Volume14 浅井戸の新たな取水技術「リングベース・コレクター」 日本の水道は、世界を見てもトップレベルの普及率を誇ります。一方で、高度経済成長を支えた取水設備、 管路、水処理設備の老朽化に伴い、更新の時期を迎えつつあります。今回は、取水設備の更新にスポットを当ててみたいと思います。 Volume13 持続可能エネルギー「SAF」とナガオカ 脱炭素が求められている世界のエネルギー分野。石油由来のジェット燃料を多く使う航空業界は、持続可能なエネルギーにシフトし始めました。今回は、注目されている「SAF」と、株式会社ナガオカとの関わりについて、ご紹介致します。 Volume12 日本の産業を支える工業用水 株式会社ナガオカは、日本の上水道だけではなく、工業向けに使われる「工業用水」の供給も下支えております。今回は、日本の産業の要である工業用水についてご紹介します。 Volume11 日本の上水道とナガオカグループ 株式会社ナガオカは、新しくグループの一員となった矢澤フェロマイト株式会社と共に、日本の上水を支え続けております。今回は、日本の上水道、浄水場事情についてご紹介します。 Volume10 への取り組みが進められているようです。 今回、あるプログラムで大阪市立新 巽中学校の生徒さんが当社の SDGs への取り組みを学ぶため、当社を訪問されました。 Volume8 変わりゆくエネルギー、求められるエネルギーのあり方 エネルギー問題や地球温暖化問題についての危機感が高まる中、今回は、私達のエネルギー事業分野で起こっている変化について、ご紹介したいと思います。 COMPANY 企業情報 巨大な反応塔内の高温・高圧・高腐食のシビアな環境下で使用されるため、高い強度と高度な技術が要求されます。 そして、内部装置であるインターナルを経由して生み出される製品は、私たちの暮らしに欠かせないものの数々です。 Scroll BUSINESS LINE プラント内で生み出される 化学原料 の プロセス と当社製品 石油精製・ 化学プラント 日々の生活で必要な燃料や化学繊維。 石油精製・ 触媒再生機能を有する接触改質ユニット用反応器は、石油精製および石油化学プロセスに使用される反応器の一つです。この反応器内で連続式に触媒を反応させ、再度使用をする為、再生塔に送られます。この反応塔及び再生塔はラジアルフロー式で、その内部機器には当社製のナガオカスクリーン・バスケットが使用されており、高効率で最も適した内部装置として主要プロセス・オーナーから推奨されています。 ナガオカスクリーンにより触媒の目詰まりや損傷を抑え、円滑な触媒の流れを促進します。これは、当社の連続的な縦方向のスロットと滑らかな表面によって実現されています。 PRODUCTS 製品について ラジアルフロー型反応器におけるインターナル ナガオカスクリーンは縦型反応塔における触媒容器としても最適な製品です。ナガオカスクリーンはその強靭な構造により、高温の運転稼動下において優れた性能を発揮しています。 ダウンフロー型反応器における触媒容器 ダウンフロー反応器では、ナガオカスクリーンは触媒支持用のみならず吸着触媒、イオン交換樹脂サポート等でも適用され、石油化学の広い分野で使用されています。 触媒層に大きな負荷や圧力損失が掛かるため、これを支える内部品には強固な構造が求められます。当社はプロジェクト初期の設計段階から顧客、プロセス・オーナーに協力することをモットーとしています。 QUALIFIED SUPPLIER 認証サプライヤー インターナルの認証サプライヤーは、世界で数社、日本で1社のみ business_summary: Yamashin-Filter Corp. operates as a filter manufacturer in Japan, Asia, the United States of America, Europe, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Construction Machinery Filter Business and Air Filter Business. The company manufactures, develops, and sells filters for construction and agricultural machines, drive-trains, fuel systems and various filter products for industrial and precision machines, and industrial filter related parts; and nano filter products. Its construction machinery filters, including hydraulic fluid filters to protect hydraulic equipment, such as cylinders; engine oil filters that are used in various types of engines to filter fine dust in engine oil; fuel filters used to construction machinery to remove dust and moisture contained in fuel for diesel engines; transmission filters for transmission mechanisms such as bulldozers and wheel loaders; industrial filters to filter hydraulic and lubricating oils, and other liquids in a range of industrial machinery; and process filters, which are used for filtration and separation in manufacturing processes across a range of industries, including electronic parts, precision components, LCD displays, and food products. The company also provides various types of air filters for a range of settings, such as office buildings, factories, equipment, and vehicles; and medical-grade masks and replacement inner sheets that are made using YAMASHIN NANO FILTER. The company was formerly known as Yamashin Industry Inc. and changed its name to Yamashin-Filter Corp. in October 2005. Yamashin-Filter Corp. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

business_summary: HIRANO TECSEED Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of coating and laminating equipment, and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. It operates through Coating machine related equipment, Chemical machinery related equipment, and Other segments. The company offers optical function film, flexible board, dry film, electronic materials, battery electrode, adhesive, release film and paper, carbon fiber prepreg, synthetic leather, hot-melt, and other coating lines. It also provides non-woven dryers, ceramic sheet forming lines, film stretching lines, glass cloth production lines, and multicoaters. HIRANO TECSEED Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Nara, Japan.

テクノスマートは1912年の創業以来、新しい製品を世に出そうと挑戦されるお客様の声にこたえ、時代の変化に合った最適なソリューションを提供してきました。現在、私たちの塗工乾燥技術は、ディスプレイやエネルギー関連機器など、社会を支える製品づくりの様々な現場で使われています。その技術で最終製品の品質を高め、人々の生活を進化させることに、大きな責任と誇りをもっています。 私たちの根底にあるのは「技術者魂」です。それは、日本の「ものづくり」の精神を大切にし、自ら考え、最後までやり抜く姿勢そのものです。 かつては私自身も、何もないまっさらなところから設計図を描き、新しい機械をたくさん作ってきました。設計・積算・営業・製造・資材など様々な仕事を経験するなかで、時として困難に直面することもありましたが、何度も考え、みんなで知恵を出し合い、手法をこらして乗り越えてきました。納得のいくものが実現できたときは、技術屋としての大きな喜びを感じます。 日本にとどまらず、世界中で「テクノスマートなら必ず形にしてくれる」と言っていただけるよう、これからもより一層、技術を磨き続けます。そして、私たちにしか出せない塗工乾燥の新たな価値を追求し、お客様の思いに真摯に向き合い、ともに次なる100年も世界中の人々の生活を進化させてまいります。 経営理念 株式会社テクノスマートの経営理念・企業行動指針等をご紹介いたします。 会社概要・会社沿革 business_summary: Hisaka Works, Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. It operates through Heat Exchanger, Process Engineering, and Valve segments. The Heat Exchanger segment offers multi gap plates, semi-welded plates, fin tubes, double-lined gasket plates, plate condensers, corrugated plate patterns, dual wall plates, brazed plate heat exchangers, and sea water solutions. This segment's products are used in various applications, such as general manufacturing, chemicals, pulp and paper, pure water, cooking oil, steelmaking, petroleum refining, ships, soda, electricity, beer, and sulfuric acid. The Process Engineering segment provides food machinery, such as sterilizers, evaporator-concentrator systems, factory automation systems, and testing machine and other equipment; pharmaceutical purposes sterilizers, pharmaceutical liquid continuous sterilizers, evaporation concentrator systems, pure steam generators, plant engineering, and development test laboratory; and dyeing and finishing machinery consisting of liquid dyeing, multi-purpose air jet processing, dyeing processing, beam-dyeing, and cheese dyeing/drying machines, as well as options for dyeing equipment. The Valve segment offers various valves, such as 2-way ball, 3-way ball, 4-way ball, and diaphragm valves. The Other segment engages in the solar power generation business. The company was formerly known as MITSUISHI Ind. and changed its name to Hisaka Works, Ltd. in August 1951. Hisaka Works, Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd., provide fluid control solutions primarily for Water in Japan and internationally. The company develops, manufactures, and sells pumps, valves, devices, special alloys, and parts. The company offers self-priming centrifugal, enhanced self-priming, de-foaming/degassing, multistage and enhanced self-priming, turbine, process, centrifugal, multistage centrifugal, double suction volute, and mixed-flow volute pumps. It also provides non-water hammer check valves; wafer-type check valves; constant flow regulator valves; float-type regulator valves; and pilot-type regulator valves, including constant pressure, constant flow rate, liquid level-1 regulator, liquid level-2 regulator, safety, pressure relief, pressure sustaining, differential pressure regulator, and emergency shutoff valves. In addition, the company offers liquid-air switch valves and automatic-cleaning strainers; and special and seawater resistant stainless steel, casting parts, and non-external-flushing mechanical seal products. Further, the company provides installation and piping services. The company's products are used in ultra-pure water production, agricultural irrigation, civil engineering, construction, electric power generation, city water, sewage, chemical processing, plant equipment, food, medicine, aquariums, fisheries, and hot springs applications. It serves government and municipal offices, and other companies. The company was formerly known as Yokota Pump Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd. in 1959. Yokota Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

business_summary: Yamabiko Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells agricultural machinery in Japan, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through Outdoor Power Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, and General Industrial Machinery segments. The company manufactures, sells, and rents handheld forestry and landscape maintenance machinery, such as chain saws for limbing, felling, and pruning trees; trimmers and brush cutters for grass cutting, mowing, and clearing; and power blowers for blowing, collecting, and shredding leaves and debris; provides boom sprayers for large-scale farm and crop operations; speed sprayers for fruit trees; mounted equipment for cropland pest control management, such as labor-saving pest control equipment for paddy fields, and soy and potato harvesters; generators, welding machines, lighting equipment, and high-pressure washers. Further, it manufactures and sells agricultural drainage pipe burying machinery; contract logistics; and manufactures and sells prototype parts for automobiles. It serves forests and agricultural fields, construction sites, parks, and homes under the Kioritz, Shindaiwa, and ECHO brand names. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Ome, Japan.

business_summary: Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd. engages in the design, construction, and sale of water production equipment in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers water treatment plants and equipment, including pure and ultra-pure water systems, pharmaceutical water production systems, wastewater treatment systems, and water reclamation systems. It also provides pretreatment systems, heat regenerative type membrane filtration equipment, coagulating sedimentation equipment, flocculation filtration, gravity filtration, and pressure filtration equipment, electrodeionization, ion exchange systems, reverse osmosis (RO) systems, vacuum and membrane degasifier, pure steam generators, package type purified water production systems, WFI production systems, ozone and hydrogen water production systems, and anti-static equipment. In addition, the company offers return contamination monitor, endotoxin monitor, H2O2 monitor, nuclepore membrane, filter cartridge, and piping and environmental materials; and site supply of pure water, and water analysis and evaluation services on a contract basis. It serves electronics, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, food, environmental energy, and analysis industries. Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Atsugi, Japan.

business_summary: NPC Incorporated engages in the machinery and environmental businesses. The company researches and develops, and sells various equipment, including automated machines for automobile, electric, precision machine, film, medicine, electronic parts, and logistics industries. It also offers photovoltaic (PV) module manufacturing equipment, including cell testers, tabbing and stringing machines, layup machines, tape applicator, bussing machine, glass/sheet feeding machine, vacuum laminator, trimming machine, framing machine, j-box attachment/soldering/potting, inspection device, repair station, and buffer; vacuum bonding machines; and vacuum insulation panels sealing machines, etc. In addition, the company provides products and services related to PV panel inspection service, PV panel inspection device, PV panel reuse/recycling, PV panel disassembly equipment, etc. Further, the company sells vegetables cultivated in plant factory using artificial light. NPC Incorporated was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

公益財団法人 松山市文化・スポーツ振興財団様 お客様の発電所概要 松山市野外活動センター内に2001年に稼動した太陽光発電システムをお持ちです。設備容量は100kWで、地上と建物の屋根上それぞれに400枚あまりのパネルが設置されています。 検査の目的 検査時点で稼働から15年以上経過していたため、健全な状態で稼働しているかどうかを安全面、性能面から総合的に確認し、不具合の有無とその原因を特定することが目的です。 検査の内容 目視検査、開放電圧測定、断線検知、地絡絶縁検査、I-V 特性測定 、サーモカメラIR検査を１日で実施しました。 検査の結果 焼損したパネル、断線してガラスも割れたパネル、異常な発熱があるパネル、絶縁不良のストリング等が見つかりました。それぞれの不具合について、想定される原因とともにレポートにしてご報告し、絶縁不良のストリングは直ちに端子を外して安全を確保しました。断線したパネルは良品パネルに交換しました。 屋根に設置したパネルは、地上のパネルと比べてFF値の低下が著しく、高抵抗化とバイパス回路の開放を引き起こしていると考えられました。設置場所が屋根であるため熱の逃げ場がなく、危険な状態であると考え、お客様に撤去をお勧めしました。その結果、屋根に設置していたパネルはすべて撤去となりました。 一方、地上のシステムは、不具合のあるパネルは良品パネルと交換され、安全性が確保されたため、現在も問題なく発電を続けています。お客様はその後定期的な検査を当社に依頼され、システムの健全性、安全性を維持されています。 お客様の声～検査を終えて 「屋根上に設置していた太陽光パネルの稼働に異常がみられたため、検査を依頼しました。その結果、焼損など各部に不具合が見つかったため、安全を考慮し、屋根上のパネルを全て撤去しました。 今回の一連の検査から今後の対応方法まで、的確なご提案をいただけたことで迅速に対応することができました。 また、正常なパネルについては年一回の定期点検の際に安全確認を行うことで安全安心な施設運営に努めています。」 Hirata Corporation manufactures and sells various manufacturing line systems, industrial robots, and logistic equipment in Japan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Automotive-Related; Semiconductor-Related; and Other Automated Labor-Saving Equipment. The company offers automotive related production equipment, such as electric vehicle related equipment, including electric drive units (EDU), gear box for EDU, rotors, stators, inverters, IGBT, battery modules, battery packs, and LIB charge discharged, as well as coating and drying; engine assembly, cylinder head assembly, and piston assembly lines; transmission related equipment comprising CVT assembly, automatic transmission assembly, and DCT assembly lines; and engine and component related equipment. It also provides semiconductor related equipment, including equipment front end modules/sorters, wafer transfer robots, aligners, load ports, and SMIF openers; and panel manufacturing systems, such as coater systems, glass cutting systems, coating and lamination systems, and auto-loader systems. In addition, the company offers industrial robot equipment comprising cartesian, SCARA-type, articulated, and substrate transfer robots, as well as 3D vision systems, robot controllers, teach pendants, and robot simulators; electronics and electrical appliance production equipment that includes home electronics related automated assembly lines, and electronic components and others; and power modules consisting of mounters, vacuum reflow ovens, and ultrasonic welders. business_summary: Marumae Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, processes, and assembles precision machinery. The company's products include vacuum chambers, shower heads, exhaust plates, electrostatic chucks, heaters, upper electrodes, and targets, as well as parts for transfer systems and other vacuum components used in etching, CVD, coater/developers, sputtering, single wafer cleaning, ashing, wafer bonding, ion implantation, and annealing. It also designs, manufactures, and sells precision machine parts; inspects and repairs precision machine parts and machine equipment, as well as is involved in the fitting and sheet-metal activities. In addition, the company designs, manufactures, and sells industrial and medical equipment; and manufactures and sells aluminum ingots, billets, slabs, and alloys. Further, it engages in the development and sale of software; plate working and plumbing; transportation; and real estate leasing businesses. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Izumi, Japan.

business_summary: Tazmo Co., Ltd., together with subsidiaries engages in the development, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Vietnam, rest of Asia, North America, and Europe. It operates in three segments: Process Equipment Business; Mold and Resin Molding Business; and Surface Treatment Equipment Business. The company offers semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including bonders/debonders, cleaning systems, CMP slurry distribution systems, coaters/developers, and phosphoric acid reclamation process equipment; clean transfer equipment, such as atmospheric and vacuum robots, and pre aligners; and nanoimprint fully automated mass production equipment. It also provides FPD manufacturing equipment comprising FDP/PLP and manual coaters; precision molding dies and plastic moldings, which include mold making, injection molding, emboss carrier tapes, and precision parts; and UV irradiation systems. In addition, the company offers liquid crystal displays and other electronic device peripherals; wafer support systems; color filter manufacturing equipment; and plating processing and circuit formation equipment. Tazmo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

business_summary: General Packer Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various packaging machines and peripheral equipment, and food processing and confectionery production machinery in Japan and internationally. It provides pouch filling-sealing machines, automatic bag forming and filling-sealing machines, automatic N2 gas flushing filling-sealing machines, and special type automatics bag filling-sealing machines, as well as automatic tray and desiccant insert bag feeding packaging machines, non-instructive residual oxygen analyzers, and chocolate manufacturing machines. The company also offers flour packaging, pasta packaging, drip coffee packaging, rice packaging, stick packages outer packaging, intravenous solution bag packaging, ampoule filling gas substitution packaging, medical device packaging, health foods packaging, pet foods packaging, and seed and seedling packaging system. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Kitanagoya, Japan.

business_summary: Nabtesco Corporation manufactures and sells industrial robot parts, construction machinery, railway vehicle brake systems, and automatic doors, aircraft parts, automobile brakes and drive controls, marine, and platform safety products in Japan and internationally. It offers precision reduction gear for component and gear head types; hydraulic equipment, such as traveling units for crawlers, control valves for mini excavators, and swing units for hydraulic excavators; railroad vehicle equipment, such as unit brakes, door operators, and brake operating units; and aircraft equipment comprising flight control actuation systems and high-voltage electric power distribution units. The company also provides air dryers and wedge brake chambers for commercial vehicles, and electric compressors for electric buses; marine vessel equipment; automatic doors and platform doors for buildings; prosthetic knee joints; rollators with speed control systems; and power assist units for wheelchairs. In addition, it offers condition monitoring with fail-safe equipment and diagnostic services for wind turbines, as well as wireless power and charging systems; and designs, manufacture, sales, maintenance, and repair of packaging machines, 3D model creation devices, textile machines, and related equipment. Nabtesco Corporation was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

It is also involved in the digital and analytics business; provision of supplier relationship management and supplier registration supply chain services. MODEC, Inc. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Rheon Automatic Machinery Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and supplies a range of food processing machines in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Food Processing Machinery Manufacturing and Sales Business, and Food Manufacturing and Sales Business. The company provides encrusting machines comprising single and multi-row models, options, and peripheral equipment; and bread making machines such as line; and related equipment for producing confectioneries, breads, savory, and pastry. It also offers automatic machinery services; technical services; and maintenance services, such as periodic inspection, overhaul, and maintenance workshop. In addition, it offers automatic filling machines, martian series, stress-free bread systems, pastry lines, extruders, and peripheral automation equipment; repair and maintenance services, and distributes purchased products including ovens, mixers, and packaging machines. Further, it produces and sells bread, confectionery, croissants, Danish pastries, pies, cookies, frozen roll-in dough, and natural yeast bread starters; and manufactures and sells aluminum castings, and develops, manufactures, and sells natural yeast bread starters. Rheon Automatic Machinery Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.

business_summary: SMC Corporation manufactures and sells automatic control equipment in Japan, the United States, China, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers air management system, directional control valves, air cylinders, rotary actuators/air grippers/magnet grippers, electric actuators/cylinders, vacuum equipment, air grippers for collaborative robots, compact compressor, air preparation equipment, modular F.R.L., pressure control equipment, booster regulators, lubrication equipment, gas generator, fittings and tubing, flow control equipment, speed controllers, silencers/exhaust cleaners/pressure gauges, and air blowing equipment. It also provides switches/sensors/controllers, static neutralization equipment/ionizers, industrial device communication equipment/wireless system, process valves, chemical valves/fittings and tubing/needle valves, process pumps/diaphragm pumps, temperature control equipment, process gas equipment AP tech, high vacuum equipment, industrial filters/sintered metal elements, pneumatic instrumentation equipment, hydraulic equipment, and specialized products for general use. In addition, the company offers clean series/low-particle generation, fluoropolymer equipment PVC equipment, series compatible with secondary batteries series 25A-, and copper, fluorine-free equipment series 20-; ISO, IO-link compatible, and ATEX compliant products; arc welding process and grease-free nitrogen (N2) compatible equipment; equipment for food manufacturing and semiconductor industries; and pickup contents. It serves automobiles, semiconductor/liquid crystal/electric, machine tool, food/beverages, physicochemical/medical/pharmaceutical, agriculture, energy, production facility, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Shoketsu Kinzoku Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SMC Corporation in April 1986. SMC Corporation was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

business_summary: Hosokawa Micron Corporation provides powder and plastic processing equipment in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers powder processing equipment for grinding, classifying, blending and drying powder materials and products used in various industries; dust collection equipment for environmental protection and product recovery; and chemical hazard prevention equipment for the protection of workers during pharmaceuticals development and manufacture. It also provides machines for milling, mixing, particle design, agglomeration, feed and discharge, laboratory technology, bag filters, protection and production isolation, and engineering, as well as after-sales, toll processing, analysis, and preventive maintenance services. In addition, the company is involved in the contract research, development, manufacture, and sale of new materials, cosmetics, and hair growth products based on nanocomposite particle technology. Further, the company engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and system engineering of multi-layered performance films for use in food packaging; protection of electronic equipment; and single-layer film manufacturing equipment. It provides its products for energy, IT, automobile, chemicals, minerals, pharmaceuticals, food, polymer drying/SSP, containment, and metal industries. The company was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Hirakata, Japan.

business_summary: Union Tool Co. designs, manufactures, and sells of cutting tools, linear motion products, and metal machining equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers printed circuit board (PCB) drills/routers, ULF coatings, diamond coated routers, and P series ultra precision micro-hole drills; PCB tools-related equipment; carbide end mills; linear motion products; and crossed roller guide and optical glass scale measuring instruments. It also provides roll dies and incremental dies, rack dies, rolled products, screw manufacturing dies, coating rods, and forging tools, as well as myBeat wearable heart rate sensors, heart rate variability analysis tool, and remote watching radar for small room. The company was formerly known as Union Chemical Research Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Union Tool Co. in 1971. Union Tool Co. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: Zuiko Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and maintains disposable hygiene product manufacturing systems in Japan and internationally. Its converting machines are used to produce baby and adult diapers, feminine napkins, and face masks, as well as pet sheets and nursing pads, incontinence pads. The company also offers medical equipment and intermediary medical systems; pet care products; recycling equipment; and equipment, systems, and related software products related to converting machines. Zuiko Corporation was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Oiles Corporation manufactures and sells bearings, structural equipment, and construction equipment in Japan and internationally. It offers bearing products, including plastic, resin, multi-layer, metal, and air bearing; dies and mold products; and slide shifters. business_summary: Seiko Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, sale, and maintenance of industrial machinery in Japan. It operates through five segments: Industrial Machinery Business, Cold Forging Business, Electrical Equipment Business, Vehicle-Related Business, and Real Estate Leasing Business. The company manufactures and sells packaging machinery products, sterilization equipment, food processing machinery, industrial machinery, and factory automation production systems, as well as cold forged products. It is also involved in the sale of electrical equipment, such as factory automation equipment, air conditioning equipment, refrigeration equipment, and solar power generation equipment; installation work of air conditioning equipment; sale of vehicles and related products; and real estate leasing, parking lot management, and car rental. Seiko Corporation was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

business_summary: Sato Corporation engages in providing automatic identification solution products in Japan and internationally. It offers printers, consumables, hand labelers, primary labels, label printing tools, labels, magnetic card, IC tags, ribbons, tickets, ink, and maintenance services. The company also provides software solutions for printing and management of label/tag data; and technical servicing support. In addition, it is involved in market research, planning, development, design, manufacturing, sales, maintenance, and sales promotion of automation solutions; planning and proposing solutions in the medical field; sales of mechatronics products and supply products; manufacturing and sale of industrial rubber products, synthetic resins, and RFID tags and labels; and development, manufacturing, and sales of RFID products and supply products; and product designing and package design consulting. It serves retail, manufacturing, food, transport, logistics, health care, chemicals industries. The company was formerly known as Sato Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Sato Corporation in January 2025. Sato Corporation was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Giken Ltd. manufactures and sells construction machinery in Japan and internationally. The company develops automated underground facilities and environmentally friendly construction solutions. The company also offers hydraulic pile press-in and extraction machines; clamp cranes; pile and unit runners; and special auxiliary equipment, including piler stages, flywheel-type pile augers, jet locks and jet nozzles, hoses, jet pipes, pile lasers, pile rollers, hose rollers, auger head replacement arm, casing scrapers, leveling jacks for reaction stands, module boxes, and spreader beams, as well as PPT System and Implant NAVI. In addition, it develops automated parking facilities, such as ECO Park, EV ECO Park, ECO Cycle, and MOBILE ECO Cycle; and provides a total support system, comprising operation trainings and lectures, various software, automation support, and machine rental. Further, the company offers press-in construction solutions, which include Gyropress, Combi-Gyro, Skip Lock, Non-staging, Overhead Clearance, Zero Clearance, Tubular Sheet Pile Press-in, and Concrete Sheet Pile Press-in methods; implant structures, such as Implant Levee, Implant Lock Levee, and Implant Bell Cap Bridge; and wall and foundation type solutions. Giken Ltd. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kochi, Japan.

business_summary: Airtech Japan, Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells clean air systems in Japan. The company offers cleanrooms/BSL-3/CPF; air showers/pass boxes; clean booths/SS-MAC series/fan filter units; clean benches/biosafety cabinets/isolators; infection prevention products. It also provides air curtain/insect control/cold storage air curtains; cleanroom equipment and supplies; biohazard systems; and dust/chemical dust removal devices/deodorizing. business_summary: Kawata Mfg. Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs and manufactures powder and particle processing equipment and systems in Japan, East Asia, China, Southeast Asia, North and Central America, and internationally. The company provides dehydrating, nitrogen, hot air, reduced pressure, and large PET resin crystal dryer; blenders, such as weighing, volumetric metering, and simple mixing types; and loaders, which consist of pellet conveying, powder conveying, and plug conveying. It also offers heating medium circulation temperature controllers, which consist of water medium temperature controller, water medium cold temperature controller, oil medium temperature controller, chillers, mold rapid cooling, and others; mixers, including high speed fluid mixing, high efficiency dry dispersion, cool mixing, and high speed floating mixing. In addition, the company provides granulators; silo tank, which comprises H series and flexible containment tank; dosage supply machines, nitrogen replacement machines, fine powder removal, pellet sorting, nitrogen gas generation, re-adsorption prevention machine, magnet, and filter washer products; system/plant equipment; colortronic equipment; and powder processing machines and systems, as well as equipment for battery, ceramic, fine chemical, food, cosmetics, drug, and paint industry. The comp Kawata Mfg. Co., Ltd. any was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. provides mechatronics, display, industrial machinery, and electronics related products in Japan and internationally. It offers burnishing systems, UV curing equipment, hard disk and semiconductor conveyor systems, automated handling machines, semiconductor handlers, Peltier systems, conveyor and bagging lines, factory automation equipment, and solar water and cell manufacturing and research and development tools; automated machinery business carrier tape business electronic components business; laser business ion beam business; hair analysis, biomarker analysis, and Eliza kit business; and shirt finishing system, wool finisher, uniform finishers, tumbler, bagging system, distributor, apparel equipment, and maintenance support. The company also provides precision polishing systems, handling technology solutions, cutting technology equipment, precision machining systems, laser technology equipment, and chemical solution application technology; medical products, healthcare products, electronic devices, printer-related equipment, fully automated hair mounting machines, fully automated hair slicing machines, and disease analysis technology solutions; and control technology systems, communication technology systems, general measurement equipment, optical measurement equipment, clothing drying, pressing and packaging equipment, mold heaters, and optical automatic double-sided inspection systems. Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Y.A.C. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2017. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Akishima, Japan.

business_summary: Komatsu Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of construction, mining, utility, forestry, and industrial machinery worldwide. It operates in three segments: Construction Machinery and Vehicles, Retail Finance, and Industrial Machinery and Others. The company offers construction and mining equipment, such as hydraulic and mini excavators, bulldozers, wheel loaders, dump trucks, rope and hybrid shovels, continuous miners, and jumbo drills; and demolition, waste, and recycling equipment, including mini shovels, mobile crushers, and hydraulic excavators with a cutter, pulverizer, and magnet. It also provides forklifts and motor graders; excavators with harvesting head, mini excavators with grapple, harvesters, forwarders, and feller bunchers; counterbalance type electric forklifts and internal combustion forklifts; and industrial machinery equipment comprising presses, transfer machines, battery manufacturing equipment, wire saws, thermo modules, thermoelectric generation module, EH sensor device, temperature control products, and press brakes and laser cutting sheet-metal machinery. In addition, the company offers industry equipment consisting of tunnel boring machines, pipe layers, towing tractors, and engines. Further, it is involved in rent construction machinery; lease a portion of the land and building; businesses related to transportation, warehousing, and packaging; sale financing for mining machinery; and development, sale, and servicing of forging and sheet metal. Komatsu Ltd. was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Sumitomo Heavy Industries, Ltd. manufactures and sells general machinery worldwide. It operates through four segments: Mechatronics, Industrial Machinery, Logistics & Construction, and Energy & Lifelines. The Mechatronics segment offers gearmotors, gearboxes, motion control drives, motors and inverters, drive solutions, precision positioning equipment, control systems, motion components, cryocoolers, and cryopumps. Its Industrial Machinery segment provides Plastics machinery, film forming machines, precision forgings, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, accelerators, medical machines and equipment, forging press machines, air-conditioning equipment, and defense equipment. The Logistics & Construction segment offers Hydraulic excavators, mobile cranes, road machinery, material handling systems, logistics systems, and automated parking systems. Its Energy & Lifelines segment provides power generation equipment, air pollution control equipment, water and sewage treatment systems, turbines, pumps, mixing vessels, food processing machinery, ships, and marine structures. The company was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction machineries in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Russia, CIS, Africa, the Middle East, the Asia-Pacific, and China. The company operates in two segments, Construction Machinery Business and Specialized Parts and Service Business. It offers excavators and wheel loaders, hydraulic excavators, compaction equipment, and rigid dump trucks. The company also provides ICT construction solutions; ConSite that monitors machines' operational status and alarms by sending monthly operational reports, as well as notifies emergency alarms; Fleet Management System, which offers real-time monitoring of dump truck for optimizing vehicle operations; and Autonomous Haulage System for mining operations. In addition, it provides parts and services; used equipment under the PREMIUM USED brand; machinery rental services under the PREMIUM RENTAL and REC brand names; and parts remanufacturing services. Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

Nikko Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of asphalt mixing and concrete batching plants in Japan, China, and internationally. The company operates through Concrete Plant Related Business; Environment and Transportation Related Business; Crusher Related Business; and Manufacturing Contract Related Business segments. It offers asphalt mixing plants, including main units, aggregate supply units, combustion units, dust collectors, asphalt supply systems, and control systems; hot mix silo, filler silo, and dust mixers; and recycling, exhaust gas treatment, deodorization, and crushing systems. The company also provides concrete batching plants comprising air seal, automatic cleaning, and waste-water treatment systems, as well as control panels and water-pressure devices; and mixers. In addition, it offers belt conveyor systems; beverage container recycling, plastic recycling, and soil remediation plants; environmental equipment; and system control panels and software, as well as maintenance services and remote control systems. The company was formerly known as Nihon Kogu Product Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nikko Co., Ltd. in February 1968. Nikko Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Akashi, Japan.

business_summary: Sansei Co.,Ltd. designs, manufactures, installs, rents, maintains, repairs, and sells washing gondola for cleaning windows in mid and high-rise buildings in Japan. The company also provides stage equipment, amusement machines, scaffolding and moving equipment for cleaning, banner systems, electric gates, and other various transport and lifting devices. In addition, it is involved in lease and rent of gondolas; build and repair ships. business_summary: TOWA Corporation engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and high-precision molds in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, Medical Device, and Laser Processing Equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment manufactures and sells precision molds for semiconductor manufacturing, molding equipment, singulation equipment, etc.; and provides aftersale services. The Medical Device segment manufactures and sells medical devices and other products. The Laser Processing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of laser processing equipment and provision of aftersale services. It also offers precision molds, end mills and drill series, TEN-systems, and mold release films. The company was formerly known as TOWA Precision Industries Limited and changed its name to TOWA Corporation in December 1988. TOWA Corporation was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

business_summary: Maruyama Mfg. Co., Inc. manufactures and sells machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers agricultural machines, such as brush cutters, furrow trimmers, riding and self-propelled grass cutters, power sprayers, backpack portable power sprayers, manual pest control machines, power spreaders, ditch cutters, aerial and electric work platforms, and rice related products; riding and large pest control machines, including stereo and boom sprayers, high creation boom, multirotor for liquid spraying, multi and shuttle sprayers, and freshhousers; green related products, comprising chainsaws, hedge trimmers, blowers, chippers, and shredders; pumps, cleaning machines, and mist generators, such as pump motor sets, industrial pumps, high pressure washers, and disinfection equipment; and fire extinguishers and disaster prevention equipment. It also provides ultra fine bubble related products, which includes ultra pumps, washing machines, ultra coolant freshers, mounted generators, and general water supply installation; power spreaders; agricultural drones; and engine pumps and cleaners. In addition, the company involved in the contract design, construction of plumbing, and real estate and leasing activities. It was formerly known as Maruyama Shokai and changed its name to Maruyama Mfg. Co., Inc. in 1937. Maruyama Mfg. Co., Inc. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: Kitagawa Corporation manufactures and supplies synthetic metals, machine tool accessories, and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers standard and advanced chucks, jaw force testers, manual chucks, rotary cylinders, chuck parts, NC rotary tables, power vises, work grippers, robot accessories, vise parts, and other peripheral equipment for machine tools such as turning centres and vertical machining centres. It also provides tower cranes for building construction, concrete mixing plants, multi-story car parking, and bridge erection machines, as well as recycling plants; and components for automotive industry. The company was formerly known as Kitagawa Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kitagawa Corporation in June 2018. Kitagawa Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

Tacmina Corporation manufactures and sells pump products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers smoothflow pumps; motor-driven metering pumps, including direct drive diaphragm, hydraulic diaphragm, and plunger metering pumps, as well as V; solenoid-driven metering pumps; and metering pump accessories, such as relief valves, back pressure valves, injection valves, air chambers/dumpers, pulse-emitting flowmeter/flow indicator/discharge amount checkers, pressure gauges, residual pressure release valves, degassing connectors, strainer-foot valves, float switch-level measurement, suction valves, hose/connector types, pump frames/covers, and parts kits. It also provides chemical injection systems; chemical tanks comprising solution, diluted sulfuric acid solution, PE, PVC, and iron-frame PVC tanks; vertical, horizontal, and transportable agitators; static mixers; and units and systems. In addition, the company offers liquid analysis and testing services, as well as device rental services. It serves the battery and electronic, film, chemical and biochemical, iron and metal, ink, coating, ceramic, plastic and rubber, pharmaceutical and cosmetic, food and drink, water treatment, and sterilization industries. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Motor-Driven Metering Pumps Rotary motion of the motor is converted to reciprocating motion by the eccentric cam mechanism. business_summary: Rorze Corporation engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of automation systems for the semiconductor and flat panel display production worldwide. The company offers wafer handling systems, including atmospheric robots, vacuum wafer robots, aligners, load ports, vacuum platforms, EFEMs/sorters, and stockers; and mask/reticle handling systems. It also provides system integration and package service, as well as host online communication, equipment control, and EDA/interface A solutions; and control devices, such as controllers, and stepping motors and drivers. In addition, the company offers life science automation products comprising mechatronics CO2 incubators, cell keepers, twist decappers and incubators, heat sealers, power seals, varistocks, and cell farms and shots. Further, it is involved in manufacturing of robot for semiconductor production equipment; the processing and export of machinery parts for robots; and importing, selling, maintaining, and broking equipment and parts. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Fukuyama, Japan.

business_summary: Kubota Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of agricultural and construction machinery in Japan, North America, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers tractors, power tillers, combine harvesters, rice transplanters, turf equipment, utility vehicles, other agricultural machineries, implements, attachments, post-harvest machineries, vegetable production equipment, intermediate management machines, and other equipment for agricultural use, weighing and measuring control systems, and cooperative drying, rice seedling, and gardening facilities, as well as rice mill plants. It also provides farm equipment, construction machinery, industrial machinery, and generators engines; and mini excavators, wheel loaders, compact track loaders, skid steer loaders, and other construction machinery-related products. In addition, the company offers ductile iron pipe, plastic pipe, valves, single stack drain fittings, and design and construction of construction works; reformer and cracking tubes, hearth rolls, TXAX, steel pipe piles, steel pipe sheet piles, and air-conditioning equipment; wastewater treatment equipment and plants, pumps and plants, membrane solutions, water purification plants, night-soil treatment plants, waste incinerating and melting plants, waste shredding and sorting plants, flue gas desulfurization apparatus, membrane methane fermentation plants, wastewater treatment plant, and valves sector. Further, it is involved in the provision of roofing, siding materials and rain gutters; logistics, retail financing, and finance leasing services; export and import of components for farm equipment, engines, and construction machinery; underwriting non-life insurance; design and construction of water and sewage; civil engineering; management of logistics and logistics information service; and building maintenance, security guarding, and facility management. Kubota Corporation was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

business_summary: Ebara Jitsugyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells environmentally related products. The company operates through Manufacturing, Engineering, and Trading business segments. The company offers manufacturing businesses, such as ozone concentration meters, ozone application equipment, industrial deodorizers and deodorizing equipment, energy-saving blowers, water treatment related equipment, infectious disease prevention products, aquaculture related products, and ZEB/ZEH related products. It also offers engineering businesses, such as water and sewage treatment facilities, including water purification plants, sewage treatment plants, various pumping stations; related design, construction, and maintenance of machinery and electrical equipment; and cloud-based remote monitoring and control system E-Qias Cloud, water supply facilities, sewerage facilities, storm water drainage pumping station facility, manhole pump facility. In addition, the company is involved in trading business, such as pumps, blowers, air conditioning, building piping restoration work, energy, water supply degassing and ionization devices, steel structure, crusher, and spirion; and purchases and sells air conditioning equipment, cooling and heating equipment, etc. related to air conditioning equipment, water supply and drainage, sanitary equipment, etc., and construction related to the equipment. Further, it provides waste liquid/waste recycling equipment, waste sorting equipment, and waste treatment equipment; medical devices, chemicals, and reagents; contracts and executes civil engineering, building construction, electrical work, plumbing, steel structures, painting, machinery and equipment installation, and other construction work; real estate leasing and management activities; animal feed and organic fertilizers; leasing and rental business; industrial waste disposal business; and temporary staffing business. business_summary: Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction of various industrial and chemical plants and environmental control facilities in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Engineering and Machinery segments. The Engineering segment includes city gas and petroleum related plants, chemical engineering plants, hydrogen generation plants, sewage treatment equipment, industrial effluent treatment equipment, diverse water treatment equipment, corrosion resistant containers made of fiber-reinforced plastic (FRP) and other products. The Machinery segment offers oil purifiers, separators and filtration machinery, seawater screening facility, mixers and related products. The company also provides belt dehydrators, cleaners, concentrators, strainers, heat exchangers, towers, vessels, ballast water treatment systems, dryers, filters, and SOx scrubber systems. The company was formerly known as Kakoki Seisaku, Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. in 1938. Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

business_summary: Tsukishima Holdings Co., Ltd. provides products and services for water and sewer facilities in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates through, Water Environment Business and Industrial Business segments. The company offers chemical injection, water treatment, and dehydration systems, as well as plant facilities including digestion tanks and incinerators; and pressure vessels and heat exchangers. It also engages in the design, manufacture, and construction services for water purification plants, sewage treatment plants, biomass usage facilities, and sludge recycling facilities; operating public-private partnership projects, including project finance initiative, design-build-operate, and digestive gas power generation projects; operational management and repair services to water and sewer facilities. In addition, the company is involved in sale of industrial chemicals; sale of machinery and supplies for environmental equipment; design, manufacture, and sale of plant systems and equipment for advanced fields comprising battery components and life science fields, such as pharmaceuticals, food products, and cosmetics; and waste treatment business; design, manufacture, and sale of equipment to contribute to environmental improvements and various chemical and general industrial equipment. Further, it engages in waste collection, transport, and intermediate treatment, and thermal recycling through alternative energy power generation; printing and bookbinding of drawings and general documents; and real estate management and leasing. The company was formerly known as Tsukishima Kikai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tsukishima Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Tsukishima Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Teikoku Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of electrical and general machinery and equipment. It offers canned motor pumps; metering pumps; canned motor agitators; electric oil pumps; protection devices for canned motor pumps; high temperature molten salt circulation pumps; sealless gas blower for SF6 gas; rotating direction indicator for motors; and roll stabilizer motors, as well as spare parts. The company also provides inspection, on-site and in-house repair, and maintenance services, as well as after-sales services. Its products are used in various fields, such as fine chemical, pharmaceutical, food industries, petrochemical plants, nuclear power plants, and electrical substations. The company operates in Japan, the United States, China, Taiwan, Singapore, Germany, India, and South Korea. The company was formerly known as Teikoku Electric Mfg.Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Teikoku Corporation in April 2026. Teikoku Corporation was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Tatsuno, Japan.

business_summary: Tokyo Kikai Seisakusho, Ltd. manufacture and sells printing machines and press control systems in Japan, Asia, and North America. The company offers factory automation; processing and assembly; newspaper rotary press; and automation and labor-saving equipment/systems, including automatic paper threading device, automatic plate loading and unloading device, printing air conditioning system, newspaper production control system, and production management control system. It also provides newspaper and commercial printing press peripherals, such as automatic register control device, cutoff control system, paper monitoring device, X system, spray dampening system, newspaper production control system, monitorproof system, and automatic ink and dampening solution control system; rotary printing press maintenance services; power generation and electricity sale; and digital and newspaper printing. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Kikai Seizou Company, Ltd. and changed its name to Tokyo Kikai Seisakusho, Ltd. in January 1916. Tokyo Kikai Seisakusho, Ltd. was founded in 1874 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Ishii Hyoki Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electrical machinery and peripheral electronic machinery parts in Japan. The company operates through electronic device parts manufacturing equipment, display and electronic components, and other divisions. It offers devices, such as graphic operation panel LCD systems; switch panel units; silk printing, label printing, and alumite nameplates; film formation products; printed circuit board parts; and precision sheet metal processing products. The company also provides polishing and surfacing machines for use in the production of printed circuit boards, FPCs, and electronic parts; and deburring machines for use in the surface treatment of clutch discs, brake pads, and other automobile parts. In addition, it offers PI inkjet systems for liquid crystal displays, as well as related maintenance services. The company serves electronics and automobile industries. Ishii Hyoki Co., Ltd. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Fukuyama, Japan.

business_summary: TESEC Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor test equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers DC static characteristics and inductive load one-pass test system for SiC/GaN power semiconductors; power device test system; IPD/IPM test system; thermal resistance tester; inductive load tester; and dynamic test system. It also provides various handlers comprising tri-temp lead frame strip test, film frame test, gravity, MEMS, and TAB handlers, as well as die sorters. In addition, it offers after-sales services, such as tester calibration, overhaul, and training services, as well as spare parts, warranty, maintenance, and resale services. The company was formerly known as TES Corporation and changed its name to TESEC Corporation in 1980. TESEC Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Higashiyamato, Japan.

MOSFET、IGBTなどのパワー半導体向けウェーハレベル（CP工程）全自動テストシステムです。 ブレークダウン電圧（Vds/Vdss）、漏れ電流（IDSS）、しきい値電圧（Vgs(th)）、オン抵抗（Rds(on)）などの「DC静特性測定」に加え、誘導負荷（L負荷）遮断時のアバランシェ耐量・アバランシェエネルギー試験（UIS/UIL：Unclamped Inductive Switching）をワンパス（1コンタクト）で連続測定できます。 最大2kV・200Aのハイパワー試験能力を備え、200mm（8インチ）および300mm（12インチ）ウェーハの量産検査・KGD（Known Good Die）確保に対応。東京精密製ウェーハプローバ（UF2000、AP3000＋DARUMAチャック）との完全統合ソリューションにより、車載・産業用パワーデバイスの高品質かつ高効率な検査を実現します。 471-TT Version LAの詳細・仕様を見る 高スループットウェーハパラレル測定対応 8/16パラレル・UIS測定 471-TT 471-TTは、ウェーハ測定工程における複数チップ同時測定を実現するパワーデバイス用DCテストシステムです。8パラレルおよび16パラレルの同時測定に対応し、従来のシングル測定方式と比較して大幅なスループット向上を実現します。パワー半導体の量産検査工程における生産性向上とテストコスト削減に貢献し、高効率なウェーハテスト環境を提供します。 また、テセックが培ってきた高電圧・大電流測定技術を継承し、最大2kVの高電圧印加に対応しています。SiC MOSFET、GaN HEMT、IGBT、ダイオードなど各種パワー半導体デバイスのDC特性評価を高精度に実施できるだけでなく、市場ニーズの高いアバランシェ測定にも対応しています。これにより、SiCデバイスや次世代パワー半導体の品質評価、信頼性評価、量産工程での検査効率向上を支援します。 さらに、ニーズが多いRg、Cissなどの容量測定にも対応。LAN通信による高速データ転送や高速リレー切換機能により測定時間を短縮し、生産ライン全体のタクトタイム改善に貢献します。EV向けパワー半導体、産業機器用インバータ、再生可能エネルギー機器向けデバイスなど、大量生産が求められるパワー半導体市場に最適なテストソリューションです。 471-TTの詳細・仕様を見る パワーモジュール・スマートパワーデバイス評価 530-IT 530-ITは、TESECが長年培ってきたパワーデバイス測定技術とICテスタ技術を融合し、IPD（Intelligent Power Device）やIPM（Intelligent Power Module）の評価・検査に最適化したテストシステムです。ロジックICとパワーデバイスが一体化された複雑なパワー半導体製品に対応し、開発段階の特性評価から量産工程の品質検査まで幅広い用途で活用できます。 近年、EV（電気自動車）、産業機器、エアコン、サーボモータ、再生可能エネルギーシステムなどに搭載されるIPMやパワーモジュールでは、高度な保護回路や制御回路の内蔵が進んでいます。530-ITは、こうした高機能パワー半導体の特性評価に必要な多彩な電源・測定機能を備え、デバイス性能と信頼性を効率的に評価します。 また、最大2.2kV・67Aの高電圧・大電流測定に対応し、拡張構成では最大200Aまでの評価が可能です。さらに、外部測定器との連携機能やパラレル測定機能を備え、多様化するパワー半導体市場に柔軟に対応できる拡張性の高いテストプラットフォームを提供します。 530-ITの詳細・仕様を見る パワー半導体ダイナミック特性測定システム | Eon/Eoff・trr評価 3430-SW 3430-SWは、IGBTおよびMOSFETのダイナミック特性を高速かつ高精度に評価するパワー半導体向けダイナミックテストシステムです。スイッチング時間測定、短絡耐量試験（I-Short）、逆回復特性（trr）評価など、パワーデバイスの実動作に近い条件での評価を実現します。 SiC MOSFETや高耐圧IGBTなど、近年のパワー半導体には高効率化と高信頼性が求められています。3430-SWは最大1500V、1000Aクラスの試験条件に対応し、EV向けインバータ、産業機器、再生可能エネルギー用電力変換システム向けデバイスの開発および品質評価を支援します。 3430-SWの詳細・仕様を見る パワー半導体熱抵抗測定システム | SOA試験・信頼性評価対応 4324-KT 4324-KTは、トランジスタ、ダイオード、MOSFET、IGBTなどのパワー半導体デバイスを対象とした熱抵抗測定およびSOA（Safe Operating Area）評価システムです。過渡熱抵抗測定によりデバイスの発熱特性を評価するとともに、安全動作領域試験によって信頼性や耐久性を検証できます。 EV向けパワー半導体、産業用インバータ、再生可能エネルギー向け電力変換装置など、高信頼性が求められるアプリケーションでは、熱設計と信頼性評価が重要です。4324-KTは熱特性評価とSOA試験を1台で実施できるため、開発効率向上と品質保証強化に貢献します。 4324-KTの詳細・仕様を見る パワーデバイス用DCテスタ 431-TT 個別半導体を中心とした素子の静特性を測定するテストシステムです。 メインフレームでは標準で1.2KV/65A(C-E間のみ130A)を印加する能力を持ち、2.2kV/65A(C-E間のみ200A)まで印加範囲を拡張する事が可能です。 また、オプションユニットを追加する事により10kV/1200Aまでの測定に対応する事が可能です。 business_summary: Takatori Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor and liquid crystal related equipment, multi wire saws and textile machinery, and medical devices primarily in Japan and internationally. The company offers precision cutting machinery for sapphire, SiC, and GaN substrates; solar panels; quartz crystals; LT and LN products; GaAs, Gap, and InP products; magnets; ceramics; and materials for research and development. It also provides semiconductor equipment for LED/RF devices, TAIKO processes, wafer protection tape lamination and removal machines, wafer mounters, UV irradiation equipment, film resist lamination machines, package mounters, substrate(H-WSS) processing equipment, and MEMS. In addition, the company provides display equipment for LCD panel surface cleaning, polarizer attaching, and touch panel bonding process machines; vacuum lamination for large substrates; carbon fiber/thin film solar cell sheet and apparel-related textile equipment; and medical devices. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Kashihara, Japan.

business_summary: Sintokogio,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells foundry, surface treatment, casting, environmental, conveying, special machinery, and other equipment in Japan, China, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company engages in electronic core materials and ceramics businesses. It also offers green sand and v-process molding, chemically bonded sand, and aluminium casting products; dust collection and fire prevention system, exhaust gas and water treatment products; powder treatment products and technologies; and force sensors. In addition, it provides flooring and electric cylinders, as well as image processing measuring machines and calibration of measuring instruments and machines. Further, it provides shot and air blasting machines, shot peening machines, barrel and precision brush polishing equipment, high-precision micro-machining equipment, surface evaluation equipment, surface treatment parts, abrasives, polishing, materials, etc.; mold molding and V process equipment, core molding and casting sand treatment equipment, and automatic pouring and sand coating equipment; casting equipment and parts, powder and granular processing equipment, wear-resistant castings, etc; dust collectors, deodorizers, wastewater treatment equipment, VOC gas purification equipment, and environmental business components; lifting devices, step-climbing machines; and organic EL panel manufacturing equipment and automated lines. Additionally, it provides dispersizers, battery raw material supply equipment, 3D equipment, 3D printers, ceramic products, molding equipment, automotive door assembly equipment, metal magnetic powders, sterile environment provision equipment; and special machinery business parts, nursing care and welfare products, etc. The company was formerly known as Kubota Seisakusho, Ltd. and changed its name to Sintokogio,Ltd. in February 1960. Sintokogio,Ltd. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
